title: Bound restored Rust link trust records by configured peer capacity
description: Correctness review of wm48 found LinkLayer::restore_peer_trust_state validates conflicts but can insert a signed record when peers.len()==max_peers, exceeding the configured bounded trust/replay capacity. Reject restore at capacity before mutation; test that state remains unchanged.
notes: Fixed restore capacity: validates configured-peer and replay capacities before any mutation; non-mutation test added. Full link tests/clippy pass.
